# Validation

The automated tests cover:

- mixed equality/inequality `auglag` with an infeasible start;
- the same problem with objective gradient and both Jacobians generated by
  `numDeriv-fortran`;
- the three-variable example from the R `auglag` documentation;
- equality-only and inequality-only augmented-Lagrangian paths;
- an active inequality-boundary solution;
- legacy `constrOptim.nl`, `augpen`, and `adpbar` paths;
- maximization under an equality constraint;
- rejection of an infeasible initial point by the strict barrier method.

The documented three-variable problem converges to approximately `(0,0,1)` with
objective value 1 and all constraints satisfied.
